identity.name: Stal Tech Invest Design System
identity.visual_mood: Industrial Brutalism, Concrete, Brushed Steel, High Contrast

primary.description: Safety Orange - Use for primary CTAs and key highlights

secondary.description: Zinc 800 - Used for secondary buttons and surface accents

accent.description: Steel Blue - For technical details or trust indicators

layout.grid_strategy: Bento Grid (Mode A for Marketing, Mode B for Specs)

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-12 px-8 rounded-none font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all duration-300 hover:translate-x-1 hover:-translate-y-1 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-12 px-8 rounded-none font-medium uppercase tracking-wider border border-white/10

cards.style: bg-surface border border-white/5 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300 p-8 relative overflow-hidden group
cards.hover_effect: Add a subtle glow or slide-up effect on hover

navigation.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/5

visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle noise texture overlay on the background (opacity 0.03) to give a concrete feel.
decorations: Technical crosshairs (+) in corners of sections
Vertical grid lines (opacity 0.05) running through the page
Warning stripes (diagonal lines) for emphasis areas

setup: Install fonts: Barlow Condensed and Manrope
Configure Tailwind theme to match the 'colors' section exactly
Set default dark mode in index.css (force dark theme)
layout_rules: Use the Bento Grid for the Services section. Make the 'Installation' card the largest.
Ensure the Language Switcher (PL/DE) is visible in the top right of the Navbar.
The 'Why Choose Us' section should use a grid with technical icons.
Contact section MUST have the Google Map embed on the right and form on the left.
content_rules: Use 'Stal Tech Invest' as the brand name.
Include the 15+ years experience badge prominently in the Hero.
List clients: Mercedes-Benz, Amazon, Ford, Nobilia in a marquee or grid.
universal_guidelines: Do not use rounded buttons. Keep them sharp/rectangular.
Do not use purple or violet.
